proposed_comments.title: Escape fixture paths embedded in PowerShell literals

confidence.rationale: The target path is interpolated inside a PowerShell single-quoted literal; a valid path containing an apostrophe terminates that literal.

proposed_comments.body:
### Escape fixture paths embedded in PowerShell literals (1/3)

**Severity:** `medium`

A temporary path containing an apostrophe terminates the PowerShell single-quoted argument and prevents the holder process from opening the target. Double embedded apostrophes before inserting `TargetPath`; apply the companion path escapes in this atomic group as well.

```suggestion
        "try { $handle = [IO.File]::Open('" + TargetPath.Replace("'", "''") + "', 'Open', 'Read', 'Read') } " +
```

proposed_comments.title: Escape fixture paths embedded in PowerShell literals

confidence.rationale: The error-log path is interpolated inside a PowerShell single-quoted literal; apostrophes can also break this failure-reporting path.

proposed_comments.body:
### Escape fixture paths embedded in PowerShell literals (2/3)

**Severity:** `medium`

If this valid temporary path contains an apostrophe, PowerShell cannot parse the `Set-Content` target and the fixture loses its diagnostic log when opening the lock fails. Escape `HolderErrorLogPath` using PowerShell's doubled-apostrophe rule and apply the companion path escapes in this atomic group.

```suggestion
        "catch { $_.Exception.ToString() | Set-Content '" + HolderErrorLogPath.Replace("'", "''") + "'; exit 1 } " +
```

proposed_comments.title: Escape fixture paths embedded in PowerShell literals

confidence.rationale: The marker path is formed from RootFolder inside a PowerShell single-quoted expression; apostrophes can make marker creation fail.

proposed_comments.body:
### Escape fixture paths embedded in PowerShell literals (3/3)

**Severity:** `medium`

The readiness marker path also embeds a filesystem path in a PowerShell single-quoted expression. An apostrophe in `RootFolder` breaks marker creation, so the test reports a holder as not ready even when its file handle opened; escape this value and apply the companion path escapes in this atomic group.

```suggestion
        "New-Item -ItemType File -Force -Path ('" + RootFolder.Replace("'", "''") + "\\ready-' + $PID + '.marker') | Out-Null; " +
```
